messages:
sam (finance): Heads-up: launching two billing changes on 2027-03-01 to help customers with month-end churn and negotiated contracts: (1) Credit carryforward: small unused starter/bonus credits can be rolled to the next billing period automatically, and (2) Contractual discounts: per-tenant negotiated unit-price overrides will appear as explicit discount lines on invoices. Dry-run telemetry begins 2027-02-01.

lara (product): Why: carryforward reduces surprise lost credits for customers who tested late in the cycle; visible discount lines improve transparency for enterprise deals and partner resells. Neither change will retroactively alter past invoices.

diego (eng-billing): Implementation notes: feature flags carryforward_credits_v1 and contract_discounts_v1. We'll emit two new CSV columns: carryforward_credits_remaining and contract_discount_code. Also a new invoice line type 'discount' and header X-Redwood-Contract-Discount: <code>|dry-run. During Feb we'll emit advisory columns only; billing won't change until 3/1.

diego (eng-billing): Sample CSV header:```
invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,route,reported_tokens,billed_tokens,unit_price_usd,contract_discount_code,discount_amount_usd,carryforward_credits_remaining,total_amount_usd
```
Note: discount_amount_usd is a new column (nullable). Parsers must tolerate extra trailing columns.

anya (sales): For AEs: please flag any customers with negotiated pricing so we can whitelist them for early previews. Also, need a clear line for quoting: "You will see negotiated discounts as separate lines on invoices for clarity."

ruth (support): CS Q: if carryforward shows in the CSV during dry-run, what do we tell customers? Will it change billing?

sam (finance): Dry-run = telemetry-only. In February exports you'll see carryforward_credits_remaining populated but invoices unchanged. For March onward, carried credits reduce billed amount before any discounts. We'll publish an examples doc (mapping of scenarios).

diego (eng-billing): API additions: GET /v1/invoices?include_advisories=true will return advisory fields during dry-run. We'll also add response header X-Redwood-Carryforward: enabled|dry-run. Feature flag toggles per-tenant so Sales can opt customers into preview.

anya (sales): Great. I'll compile a short list of enterprise customers who should be in preview. Also want instructions for AEs on how discount codes surface in Stripe/partner flows.

ruth (support): Request: canned script for customers who see discount lines or carryforward fields in Feb. Suggested: "We're piloting clearer invoice fields; exports in Feb are advisory only and won't change amounts until March 1 unless you're in the preview program."

lara (product): Agreed. Add to playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/carryforward-contract-discounts (internal). Action owners: eng (diego) - feature flags + API + dual-emit; finance (sam) - examples & reconciliation plan; support (ruth) - canned replies; sales (anya) - preview whitelist & customer comms.

diego (eng-billing): Edge cases: tax calculations and reseller passes need coordination. We'll emit discount_amount_usd pre-tax and add a discount_tax_adjustment boolean column if the discount affects tax. Flagging tax team.

sam (finance): Finance will run parallel invoices for a random 5% sample in March to confirm carryforward calculation and discount application. We'll keep old CSVs available for 45 days after go-live.

invoicing-bot: export prepared for tenant: zenstack - /exports/invoices/2027-02-05/zenstack-invoice-2255559800.csv :white_check_mark:

ruth (support): I'll draft KB + triage checklist: 1) check X-Redwood-Carryforward and X-Redwood-Contract-Discount headers; 2) confirm contract_discount_code matches sales note; 3) escalate if carried credits don't match console.

lara (product): Timeline recap: dry-run/advisory Feb 1 - Feb 28; opt-in previews during Feb; go-live March 1. We'll send customer notices 2 weeks before March 1 and post a short console banner.

sam (finance): Risks: customers with reconciliations expecting fixed line counts might break. Mitigations: dual CSVs during Feb, mapping guide, and 30-day support window for parser updates.

anya (sales): I'll prepare AE talking points and a short email for preview customers.

lara (product): Thanks team. Ping owners directly for exceptions or urgent issues.
